Title: Azure Monitor updates—Containers for China regions, Grafana dashboard template, Agent

Body.Content:
• In April 2019 we added support for Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) in China regions. As part of this support, multi-cluster view is now available in the table of contents so you can monitor multiple clusters at once. Also, AKS-Engine is now supported for China regions. For more information, please refer to the documentation.
  • Azure Monitor for containers has updated the agent to support pod annotation settings. This supports Prometheus metrics scrapping per namespace configurations via config map. Also supports descriptive error outputs to troubleshoot scrape settings. Please refer to our release note for more details. For supported Kubernetes versions, please refer to this documentation.
  • Grafana dashboard template is now available for out-of-the-box metrics collected by Azure Monitor for containers. Learn more.
